description: This file defines abstract classes and types related to property types in a web application, including encoding functions, property interfaces, and base classes for different property types with filtering and display capabilities.

classes.name: PropertyType
classes.description: Abstract base class for different property types, providing common properties and methods for display and export of property values.

classes.name: DatePropertyType
classes.description: Abstract class extending PropertyType, adding date-specific filtering methods.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes text by replacing quotes and hash symbols for safe display or processing.
